World for All Animal Care and Adoptions Works to care for stray street animals by encouraging adoptions and co-existence, providing shelter and advocating for animal welfare Silver Certified 2023 FCRA 80G 12A Transparency Rating: Transparency Rating The transparency rating is calculated based on the amount of information available for the organisation. Donate Send Message Overview PROGRAMS People ABOUT US FIELD VISIT Social --> Donate Cause Area Primary Sectors Animal & Wildlife Health Right to Information & Advocacy Media & Awareness Secondary Sectors Health & Family Welfare Financials 2024 Total Income Rs. 15,439,440 Total Expenses Rs. 28,673,247 Non Program Expenses Rs. 6,616,903 Program Expenses Rs. 22,056,344 Tip: Click on any value above to exclude it. Geographies Served Programs Animal Casualties District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra It addresses the growing cases of injured and wounded animals by operating dedicated ambulances which attend not only to hurt street animals but also pets who have been mishandled by their owners. Volunteers of the organisation are active to rescue animals and are trained to provide first-aid thereby providing immediate relief to wounded animals. Animal Overpopulation District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Overpopulation of street animals is also a cause of concern for the organisation, which regularly conducts areawise census exercises to get to know the number of stray animals. Spay and Neuter programmes are conducted to limit the sexual behaviour of stray street animals in an attempt to reduce their numbers leading to healthier animals and controlled populations. Animal Homelessness District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra The organisation strives to reduce animal homelessness by putting rescued stray animals up for adoption by caring people from society. It manages shelters where sick, injured and neglected animals are given protection and attention while also running awareness campaigns to make the public aware of the plight of the animals on the streets. Indian Perception & Advocacy District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra The organisation feels that lack of information and insensitivity to the situation also contributes to the problems of strays. It conducts awareness sessions and tries to teach co-existence with street animals and also runs campaigns and workshops in schools to sensitize the children and the public to be empathetic to strays and street animals. Milestones & Track Record World For All hosts Asia's largest annual animal adoption camp called Adoptathon and performs over 300 adoptions per year, making it the largest platform for native breed adoptions in India. --> --> Leadership Team Taronish Bulsara Co - Founder & President Malika Bhavnani Adoptions Co-ordinator Aditya Nadimpalli Volunteer Co-ordinator Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATW2259F Registration Number E-27454(m) CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID MH/2017/0173936 --> 80G AAATW2259FF20214 12A AAATW2259FE20214 FCRA 083781757 About Headquarters Mumbai, Maharashtra Since 2010 Demographies Served Animals --> Impact World for All Animal Care and Adoptions has impacted as follows: 7500 adoptions, 12000 rescues, 8500 spay-neuters and 45000 children educated. Vision and Mission Their mission is to inspire co-existence between stray animals and the people of Mumbai by finding loving homes for helpless animals and creating compassion, tolerance and humanity for those on the streets.
